verdict.rationale: Pylon documents connecting external knowledge sources as training data for its AI features, and Support Agents use content to deflect questions. This is a first-party ingestion capability, but the evidence does not say which source types are supported or how ingestion and syncing work. Missing for 10: explicit support for ingesting external help centers and docs sites, past tickets as a knowledge source, internal wiki connectors (e.g. Notion/Confluence), confirmation that ingestion needs no manual re-authoring or that content syncs automatically, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the agent ingests my help center, docs, past tickets, and internal wikis as knowledge sources without manual re-authoring

citations.quote: Make them even more powerful by connecting any external sources of knowledge you have!
Supercharge all of Pylon's AI features by connecting training data for the AI to consume.
Support Agents can deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context for your team, and take action.
